name: whatsapp-central
description: Two WhatsApp numbers in one Mac app, with one inbox and auto-unarchive. Everything stays on your Mac.

scripts.package: electron-packager . "Whatsapp Central" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --no-asar --app-bundle-id=local.whatsappcentral.app --icon=build/icon.icns --extend-info=build/Info.extra.plist --ignore='^/dist' --ignore='^/\.git' --ignore='^/docs' --ignore='^/build/logo-options' && cp build/icon.icns "dist/Whatsapp Central-darwin-arm64/Whatsapp Central.app/Contents/Resources/electron.icns" && touch "dist/Whatsapp Central-darwin-arm64/Whatsapp Central.app"
